lines.text: The oldest computer on record ran on a hand crank.
Greeks built it over two thousand years ago.
But the sky runs on too many cycles to count.
So they cut thirty bronze gears, and turned them with the crank.
But the Moon speeds up and slows down.
So one gear drives the next through a pin in a slot.
But eclipses still came without warning.
So a back dial spirals through 223 months, marking the eclipses.
Sponge divers pulled it from a shipwreck in 1901.
All of it, turned by one hand crank.
